subject: sr-english
title: Writing Job Applications
instructions: Practice for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper (new syllabus).
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: Why is it important to include both the sender's and the employer's information in a job application?
options: To ensure clear communication and proper addressing

questions.q: Which is generally shorter and tailored to a particular job?
The letter of application is essentially a —
If you have no work experience, your application should stress your —
options: education and skills from school activities

questions.q: Which of these should NOT appear in the heading of a résumé?
A cover letter should end by —
options: requesting an interview and giving contact details

sections.title: Identify the following sentences as True or False.

questions.q: A résumé should be free of errors and easy to read.
A CV is usually shorter than a résumé.
In a job application, educational qualifications need not be mentioned.
Letters to the editor and job applications are formal letters.
In a résumé, it is acceptable to include personal hobbies.
A CV is considered British in style, while a résumé is considered ________ in style.
If the employer's name is not known, begin with 'Dear Hiring ________'.
In a résumé, education and experience are listed starting with the most ________.
A cover letter is also called a ________ letter.
What is the difference between a résumé and a CV in length and detail?
questions.answer: A résumé is short (one to two pages) and gives only the skills, experience and education relevant to a job. A CV is longer and detailed, covering one's whole career, publications, awards and more.

questions.q: What are the three things a cover letter must do?
questions.answer: Catch the reader's attention favourably, convince the reader that you are qualified for the post, and request an interview.

questions.q: How should a fresher without work experience present himself in a job application?
questions.answer: Stress education and relevant coursework, and show skills gained from school projects, clubs, sports and volunteering, such as teamwork and leadership. Be positive and enthusiastic about learning.

questions.q: How do you decide whether to list education or experience first in a résumé?
questions.answer: List whichever is stronger: education first if your qualifications are strong and you have little experience; experience first if you have a year or more of relevant work.

questions.q: You are a recent NIOS pass-out. Apply for the post of Sales Assistant in a reputed car company advertised in The Times of India (Box No. 8365, C/o The Times of India, New Delhi).
questions.answer:
Aniruddh Vyas
22, Shastri Nagar, New Delhi
3 May 2026

Box No. 8365
C/o The Times of India
New Delhi

Subject: Application for the post of Sales Assistant

Dear Sir/Madam,
In response to your advertisement in The Times of India of 1 May, I wish to apply for the post of Sales Assistant.
I have passed Senior Secondary from NIOS (2026) and hold a driving licence. As class representative I developed good communication and teamwork, and I helped in my uncle's showroom during holidays, assisting customers.
My résumé is enclosed. I am available for an interview at your convenience.
Yours faithfully,
Aniruddh Vyas
